package.name: electron-builder
package.msrv: Not a Rust crate. npm engines: node >= 14.

obligations: Retain the copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions (build tool; nothing of it is shipped in the DMG).

package.note: Build-time tool only: it packs the DMG and is not part of the shipped app. Its tree (about 330 packages, see supply-chain/super-ontology-app-dependency-delta.md) is MIT, ISC, BSD, Apache-2.0, BlueOak-1.0.0, 0BSD and three WTFPL-licensed utility packages that are flagged for owner review there.

advisories.scanner: pnpm audit --json (2026-11-19, workspace lockfile; filtered to paths under apps__super-ontology-desktop)
advisories.evidence: two moderate minimatch denial-of-service advisories on the build tool path (patterns come from this repository's own electron-builder.yml, no untrusted input); no high or critical advisory on electron-builder or its build-time dependencies
